title: A polynomial invariant under nonzero translation is constant
statement: For every polynomial p∈ℂ[t] and c∈ℂ with c≠0, if p(t+c)=p(t) as a polynomial identity, then p is the constant polynomial whose value is its coefficient at degree zero.
lean_statement: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (c : ℂ), c ≠ 0 → p.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c) = p → p = Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0)
